name: PayPal USD
oneLiner: PYUSD is PayPal's regulated dollar stablecoin issued by Paxos, redeemable 1:1 and backed by U.S. Treasury reverse repos and cash deposits.
collateral: U.S. dollar deposits, U.S. Treasury securities, and reverse repurchase agreements

sources.label: KPMG PYUSD Redemption Assets Report - May 2026

applicabilityBasis.summary: PYUSD is a Paxos-issued U.S. dollar payment stablecoin distributed by PayPal with 1:1 redemption and monthly reserve attestations.

genius.notes: On December 12, 2025, the OCC granted Paxos Trust Company conditional approval to convert from its NYDFS limited purpose trust charter to a national trust bank charter (OCC NR-2025-125). This is a conditional trust-charter conversion, not a PPSI approval under the GENIUS Act (whose application framework remains in proposed-rules rulemaking). Paxos publicly announced PYUSD will align with GENIUS Act requirements as rules are finalized. The authorizationStatus remains issuer-announced-intent because no PPSI approval framework or application process yet exists. The OCC rulemaking (Bulletin 2026-3) is also scrutinizing PayPal's 4% PYUSD reward program as a potential indirect interest payment prohibited under GENIUS.

mintAuthority.summary: PYUSD is issuer-minted by Paxos-operated infrastructure; the Ethereum token (PaxosTokenV2 / AdminUpgradeabilityProxy) delegates supply control to a dedicated SupplyControl contract whose owner and the token's defaultAdmin are the same Paxos EOA. All addressable controls confirmed at block 25294757.

mintIncidents.summary: During a Paxos internal transfer, a technical error minted about $300T PYUSD before Paxos burned the excess and reissued the intended $300M amount.

controls.label: PYUSD SupplyControl owner / token defaultAdmin
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294757, SupplyControl owner() returned 0x3Af3e85f4f97De7AD0f000B724Fb77fE5ffc024B; defaultAdmin() on the PYUSD token also returned this address. eth_getCode confirms EOA (no bytecode). Proxy admin (OZ 2.x slot 0x10d6a5...) = 0xc94bcf6e1d8b3558e3b62e743630d50497e3851c; eth_getCode confirms EOA. All Paxos-operated, consistent with enterprise MPC/HSM custody.

controls.label: PYUSD ZeppelinOS proxy admin
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526176, the org.zeppelinos.proxy.admin slot resolves to this EOA and the implementation slot resolves to 0x8c35caa5fd5bdc64b6b11344ad57594a3676256a. Paxos documents that this AdminUpgradeabilityProxy admin can replace the implementation through upgradeTo or upgradeToAndCall.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: PYUSD has issuer-backed native deployments on Ethereum, Solana, Arbitrum, and Stellar; all other EVM/Tron expansion is the PYUSD0 omnichain representation minted by Stargate Hydra (LayerZero) adapters that hold supply-controller rights on each PaxosTokenV2 deployment. Because the extended route surface includes external interoperability validation, Pharos scores the multichain route as external validated network risk.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-7 (lead pyusd-paypal)

routes.reviewNote: Re-verified 2026-07-22. Wanchain's own Cardano transaction documentation identifies policy 25c5de5f5b286073c593edfd77b48abc7a48e5a4f3d4cd9d428ff935 as Wanchain-mapped and requires userBurn for its mapped tokens. Wanchain documents a rotating 25-node Storeman group using MPC and Shamir secret sharing, with more than two-thirds of nodes required to sign; the live group API returned smgID 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000041726965735f303638. That rotating off-chain group ID and threshold cannot be encoded honestly as a single Cardano contract controller in the current route schema, and the exact Cardano minting policy script identity was not published by the reviewed sources. The route therefore remains unresolved rather than fabricating a controller address.
